proposal.blind_spot: The metrics show DRAM is busy but cannot distinguish true bandwidth saturation from latency-limited execution with too few resident warps or too small a grid to saturate the memory system.

rationale.sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: HIGH -> occupancy is fine and DRAM% is real saturation, so cut DRAM bytes (fuse elementwise passes, keep intermediates in registers, avoid round trips, narrow dtypes) / LOW -> latency is not hidden, so raise occupancy via more num_warps, smaller BLOCKs, lower register/shared usage, and num_stages prefetching
rationale.launch__waves_per_multiprocessor: HIGH (>=1) -> grid fills the GPU, tune per-block tile size/vectorisation instead of restructuring / LOW (<1) -> grid too small to saturate DRAM, split rows/channels across more blocks (two-pass reduction or atomics) or use a 2D grid

split.chosen_by: llm_tiebreak:The normalized DRAM throughput percent-of-peak threshold best matches a real bandwidth-saturation regime and should generalize better than rules using absolute byte counts or extra cuts with empty branches.
